profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Distributed Systems | Kafka | Cloud & Data Platforms | High-Scale Backend (Java)
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing and scaling distributed backend systems and high-throughput data platforms.
Focused on event-driven architectures, real-time data pipelines, and cloud-native systems using Java, Kafka, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Currently leading architecture and implementation of large-scale data processing and enrichment pipelines, enabling reliable, near real-time event delivery across distributed systems.

Operate at the intersection of backend engineering, data platforms, and infrastructure—driving system design decisions, scalability improvements, and cross-team technical alignment.

Core strengths:
• Distributed systems & microservices architecture  
• Event-driven systems (Kafka, streaming pipelines)  
• Cloud-native development (Kubernetes, Docker, GCP/AWS)  
• Performance, scalability, and observability  
• Backend engineering (Java, Spring Boot)  

I build systems that scale, simplify complex problems, and deliver measurable impact.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead architecture and implementation of distributed backend systems and high-throughput data pipelines supporting large-scale event processing.

• Architect and build event-driven data pipelines using Kafka and Spark, processing millions of events with strict performance and reliability requirements
• Design scalable enrichment workflows integrating multiple data sources to support downstream analytics and external integrations
• Drive system design decisions across teams, ensuring consistency, scalability, and maintainability across services
• Partner with data engineering, platform, and product teams to deliver end-to-end distributed solutions
• Improve system performance, reliability, and observability through monitoring, optimization, and operational best practices
• Contribute to cloud and infrastructure architecture (Databricks, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led backend architecture and development of scalable microservices and event-driven systems supporting high-volume data processing.

• Designed and implemented backend services and APIs using Java and Spring Boot
• Contributed to system architecture decisions to improve scalability, performance, and maintainability
• Built and enhanced event-driven systems leveraging Kafka for asynchronous processing
• Partnered with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and scalable distributed solutions
• Mentored engineers and contributed to technical direction and best practices within the team
• Improved system performance and stability through refactoring and optimization

Tech: Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, Microservices, REST APIs, CI/CD

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description:
Led development of enterprise backend systems and integrations supporting internal business platforms.

• Designed and developed backend services and APIs for enterprise applications
• Translated business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions
• Improved application performance and reliability through code and architecture enhancements
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated solutions across systems
• Supported system integrations across multiple internal platforms

Tech: Java, Spring, REST APIs, SQL, Enterprise Applications

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained enterprise applications and backend services within a large-scale business environment.

• Built and enhanced backend components using Java and enterprise frameworks
• Contributed to system design and implementation across internal platforms
• Improved application stability and performance through code optimization
• Participated in Agile development processes to deliver features and enhancements

Tech: Java, Spring, SQL, REST APIs, Agile

positions.title: Technical Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Designed and implemented enterprise integration solutions for high-availability systems using messaging and service-oriented architecture.

• Developed a compensation-based system integrating JBoss EAP and IBM Integration Bus using JMS and MQ
• Defined system architecture and technical solutions for enterprise integrations
• Applied object-oriented design principles and best practices
• Delivered scalable and reliable messaging-based solutions

Tech: Java, JMS, MQ, JBoss EAP, IBM Integration Bus, SOA

positions.title: Senior Java Software Engineer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Designed and developed enterprise healthcare systems and backend services supporting clinical operations.

• Built an electronic clinical record system with business workflows and reporting capabilities
• Designed database schemas, stored procedures, and backend business logic
• Developed SOAP-based web services for system integrations
• Led technical planning, estimation, and requirements analysis

Tech: Java, SOAP Web Services, PostgreSQL, PL/SQL, Enterprise Systems

positions.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed enterprise-grade backend systems and integrations for healthcare and ERP platforms.

• Built backend services and REST APIs for electronic billing and ERP integration
• Designed asynchronous notification systems for event-driven communication
• Introduced CI practices and improved development workflows
• Collaborated with stakeholders to define and deliver technical solutions

Tech: Java, REST APIs, CI/CD, SQL, Enterprise Integration

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to development of large-scale enterprise healthcare systems deployed across multiple countries.

• Participated in full-stack development of hospital and primary care systems
• Implemented business logic, database design, and user interfaces
• Built integrations across multiple hospital departments (finance, HR, inventory)
• Worked within large distributed teams in enterprise application environments

Tech: Java, Enterprise Applications, SQL, Full-Stack Development

projects.title: alas-HIS Hospital Information System
projects.description: Distributed  system for the second level of attention of the Venezuela Oil Company (PDVSA). It has the modules: Electronic Medical History, Medical Staff, Billing, Accounting, Patients, Epidemiology, Reports, Laboratory, Operating Room, Pharmacy, Warehouse, Payroll, Emergencies, Hospitalization, Outpatient Consultation, Blood Bank. This system was deployed on ninety two hospitals in Venezuela during two years, it also implemented the HL7-CDA standards allowing an unique repository of patients clinical record.

projects.title: Development of the the Integral Component of Technological Applications (CIAT) for the Internal Revenue Service of Ecuador
projects.description: The Internal Revenue Service of Ecuador needs to have a comprehensive solution for the quality management of its key processes that allows it to adapt quickly to future realities and become a national and international benchmark by 2019.
